title: 2024 Topps Chrome Black Lot of 3 Darren Sproles Devin Hester Eddie George
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Lots
conditionDescription: Ungraded, near mint or better. All three cards are the exact cards pictured, shown front and back. Please review the photos.
descriptionText:
2024 Topps Composite football lot of 3, all with the Topps Chrome Black front design.

Darren Sproles - San Diego - RB - #143
Devin Hester - Chicago - WR - #108
Eddie George - Tennessee - RB - #150

Three of the game's most dangerous runners and return men. Hester holds the league career record for punt-return touchdowns; Sproles was a three-time all-star as a back, receiver and returner; George rushed for over 10,000 yards for Tennessee and was rookie of the year in 1996.

Ungraded, near mint or better. Every card is pictured front and back.

You will receive the exact three cards pictured. Shipped in sleeves and a toploader, protected.

(c) 2024 The Topps Company.
